messages:
jordan: FYI customer INC-4890. They copied the rerank cURL from Console and got back a valid 200 but all scores are 0.0 for every document. They say they did not change anything beyond copy/paste. Posting what they pasted (from macOS Terminal):

```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"query":"choose best cloud db","documents":"[\"RDS best practices\",\"Self-managed Postgres\"]"}'
```

support-bot: Created incident INC-4890 :ticket: (priority: medium)

lina: that looks similar to the other thread but with one extra misformat: `documents` is a string (escaped array). If server treats it as a single concat doc the ranking can be nonsensical but not necessarily zeroes. curious that they got exact 0.0 for all.

qa: i repro'd the grime: i pasted that same command into zsh and saw response body:
```json
{
  \"scores\": [0.0, 0.0],
  \"ranks\": [1, 2]
}
```
with HTTP 200. Verbose curl shows request body length matching a single string.

jordan: customer also shared a version where they used a payload file `payload.json` and got 400 sometimes. their payload.json looked fine in a text editor but when they `cat -v` it showed a leading \uFEFF (BOM). they said the Console \"Save to file\" button produced that file.

devex: Console \"Save to file\" bug noted. Some editors hide BOMs. For rerank the BOM confuses JSON parser on our runtime path that does a UTF-8 sniff and then tries to coerce `documents` into an array. Two bad behaviors stack: 1) Console cURL example emits `documents` as an escaped string in one variant, 2) Console save-as-file may add BOM. Combined, customers get either silent coercion (we produce strange but 200) or parser 400 depending on the path.

qa: reproduction matrix attached below (short):
- macOS zsh: copy/paste console cURL -> 200, scores all 0.0.
- macOS bash: paste -> same as zsh.
- PowerShell: copy/paste console cURL (with double quotes) -> curl.exe treats single quotes literally -> 400. Using \" in PowerShell or using --data-binary with single quotes fixes it.
- WSL: similar to macOS.

lina: curious why zeros: i instrumented the reranker runtime. When we coerce string to array by splitting on `,` heuristically, the tokenization path hits an early- bail-out for very short tokens (a bug). That path returns a zeroed score vector for some types of token streams. So two bugs: bad docs + fragile coercion + a tokenization bail-out that yields zeroes.

runtime-bot: /note The runtime currently accepts either string or array for `documents` for backward compatibility. Metric: 1.2% of rerank calls in last 7 days used string docs; among those, 14% had abnormal score distributions flagged by anomaly detector.

jordan: customer also provided the exact bytes of the body (hexdump). shows CRLF at the end of each line (\r\n) because their editor saved windows line endings. That, combined with BOM, makes our UTF8 sniff path flip to legacy parser.

devex: recommended immediate mitigations: 1) Docs: update Console snippet to show \"documents\":[\"a\",\"b\"] (array) and provide one-line and heredoc examples for POSIX and a powershell-friendly example. 2) Console: change copy button to produce single-line compact JSON (no line continuations) and Save-as-file to not include BOM. 3) Runtime: stop silent coercion of string->array; instead return 422 with clear message and example. 4) Fix tokenization bail-out that yields zero scores. 5) Support: contact affected customers, explain root cause and provide corrected commands and offer to re-run.

support-bot: INC-4890 updated: labels [docs, runtime, console], severity escalated to high.

qa: i attached repro logs to the incident (verbose curl, hexdump, which-shell). Also included a minimal python requests script that works cross-platform:```python
import requests
import os
headers = {
    'Authorization': f\"Bearer {os.environ.get('REDWOOD_KEY')}\",
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
json = {
    'query': 'choose best cloud db',
    'documents': ['RDS best practices', 'Self-managed Postgres']
}
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank', headers=headers, json=json)
print(resp.status_code, resp.text)
```

devex: i'll push a docs patch that includes these cross-shell variants and a short note about BOM and CRLF. Proposed examples to include:
- POSIX one-liner using --data-binary with compact JSON
- POSIX heredoc (bash/zsh) for readability
- PowerShell curl.exe example with escaped double quotes or using Invoke-WebRequest/Invoke-RestMethod snippets
- Python and Node fetch/examples that use a JSON array for `documents`

lina: for runtime team, please consider: a) strict schema validation returning 422 b) per-document size limit with 413 c) a clear error message when BOM/CRLF leads to legacy parse path and guidance to remove BOM and use UTF-8 without BOM.

jordan: i've notified the customer we'll reach back when docs patch and runtime validation are deployed. they're fine to wait but asked for ETA. i'll share devex + runtime ETAs once we have them.

devex: ETA: docs patch within 8 hours, console copy change in 2 business days, runtime strict schema and error message in next sprint review.

support-bot: INC-4890: owner assigned to jordan.

jordan: thanks team. i'll follow up with the customer and close once we confirm fixes.
